articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu warns Donald Trump against sale of F-35s to Turkey
articles.summary: Netanyahu warned in a Fox News interview that if the US gives Turkey F-35 fighter jets, it may upset the balance of power in the Middle East and threaten Israeli air superiority.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu aiming to prevent strengthening of US-Turkey ties, F-35 deal
articles.summary: Netanyahu's two Fox News interviews were diplomatic moves designed to pressure Washington against an F-35 sale to Turkey before Trump's NATO Summit meeting with Erdogan.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu asserted in a Fox News interview that Israel and the US are close allies, claiming he has an excellent relationship with Trump despite occasional disagreements.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu indicated his campaign objective is to end the political boycott against him and build a broader coalition government ahead of elections scheduled for October.
